mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right surface restoration company in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a surface restoration company, look for experience, positive customer reviews, and a clear understanding of your specific needs. Ensure they offer detailed proposals, use quality materials, and are properly licensed and insured. Asking for examples of previous work and checking their service area, such as Frasheski Construction in Berkeley, Oakland, and El Cerrito, can also help you make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company based on experience, reviews, clear proposals, quality materials, licensing, and service area.
